sections.title: Snapshot
sections.content: Snapshot time: 2026-11-26 03:23 UTC. Scope: daily. Date range: 2026-11-26 through 2026-11-26. Ranking basis: GitHub Trending daily star gains with the supplied attention score.

sections.title: Headline
sections.content: Today’s leading signals cluster around agent workflows: security skills, agent-ready software interfaces, coding methodologies, and retrieval tools. Visual/media creation also drew substantial attention, while MiniMind and Ghost Downloader 3 provide strong model-learning and consumer-utility counterpoints.

sections.why_notable: Its 1,652 daily stars and 10.410 attention score lead this candidate set; the README describes 85 skills, 16 slash commands, and 681 disclosed-report patterns.

sections.title: Trending Technologies and Themes
sections.content:
- **Agent workflows and software access:** Repositories package repeatable skills, plugins, and CLI interfaces so coding agents can work through defined development tasks or operate external software: Claude-BugHunter, CLI-Anything, Superpowers, Cursor Plugins, and Last30Days Skill.
- **Agent-facing research and retrieval:** Firecrawl and Last30Days Skill target the input side of agent work: acquiring material across web and other sources, then making it usable in grounded synthesis.
- **Security and policy guardrails:** Claude-BugHunter applies agent workflows to vulnerability discovery and red-team work; App Store Compliance applies structured checks to mobile publishing requirements.
- **Visual and media creation:** Diagram Design and AutoClip automate different creator tasks, while AFFiNE represents a broader local-first workspace for writing and visual planning.
- **Small-model training and education:** MiniMind emphasizes a reproducible, approachable from-scratch training path, including pretraining, fine-tuning, and preference-optimization workflows.
- **Developer and platform utilities:** Cursor Plugins provides an extension catalog and App Store Compliance a publishing checklist; these narrower tools complement the more general agent frameworks.
- **Standalone consumer utility:** Ghost Downloader 3 is a high-momentum download manager and a useful counterpoint to the dominant agent-oriented projects.
- **Languages:** Python 6, TypeScript 3, Shell 2, HTML 1 across the 12 selected repositories; Python is the largest group.

sections.title: Takeaway
sections.content: The snapshot points to a maturing agent stack: projects are addressing not only model access, but workflows, tool interfaces, research inputs, security checks, and user-facing output. Star gains are concentrated in the top of the candidate set, while practical creator and utility applications remain visible. This is a one-day attention snapshot, not evidence of durable adoption.

sections.content: GitHub Trending daily signals were the ranking source. GitHub REST repository metadata, README content, and current default-branch commits were verified for all selected repositories. Historical star snapshot deltas were unavailable because gh authentication was missing; null deltas are not zeros. No prior-window comparison was available.
